ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Estimated 98:2 ratio of low-intensity (black) to high-intensity (white) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant solid black pigmentation with discrete, high-contrast white circular spots (diameter 10-30 pixels) clustered primarily at the distal tips and scattered sporadically on the interior lobe surfaces.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Central V-shaped depression with an approximate 45-degree interior angle and a depth roughly 15% of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with pixel-amplitude variations of 5-20 pixels along the trailing boundary, most prominent on the interior sections adjacent to the median notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave sweep along the trailing edge transitioning into a convex curve toward the upward-tapering distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized clusters of high-contrast white circular pixel groups (consistent with barnacle colonization) located at the terminal edges of both left and right lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive peripheral barnacle encrustation on the lateral and trailing edges of both fluke lobes.
